Nine out of ten fisherman agree: crab is best enjoyed grilled and with just a bit of salt.|Cooking (Interface)|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== [[Link]] can make Salt-Grilled Crabs by [[Cooking]] any [[Crab]] together with [[Rock Salt]] in a [[Cooking Pot]]. There are two ways to make their default version. First, Link must use two different types of Crabs. Alternatively, another [[Ingredient]] can be added to the [[Meal]] with an effect that differs from the Crab used. Eating these dishes will restore some of Link's [[Heart]]s to his [[Life Gauge]]. A majority of fishermen enjoy Crabs most when they are prepared in this way. Based on the type of crab used, Link can make the three following variations of Salt-Grilled Crab: * '''Energizing Salt-Grilled Crab''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Salt-Grilled Crab}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
Nine out of ten fishermen agree: crab is best enjoyed grilled and with just a bit of salt.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Bright-Eyed Crab]]s. They refill a portion of Link's [[Stamina Wheel]] when eaten. * '''Mighty Salt-Grilled Crab''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Salt-Grilled Crab}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
Nine out of ten fishermen agree: crab is best enjoyed grilled and with just a bit of salt.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Razorclaw Crab]]s. When consumed, they grant Link a boost to the power of his attacks. * '''Tough Salt-Grilled Crab''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Salt-Grilled Crab}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
Nine out of ten fishermen agree: crab is best enjoyed grilled and with just a bit of salt.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Ironshell Crab]]s. Link's defensive abilities will be boosted by eating these [[Meal]]s. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} Salt-Grilled Crab returns from {{BotW}}. It can be made using the same [[Recipe]], which involves [[Cooking]] any type of [[Crab]] with [[Rock Salt]]. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} The [[Recipe]] for Salt-Grilled Crab is obtained by completing the [[Scenario]] "[[Air and Lightning]]". It is made using two [[Rock Salt]]s and two [[Ironshell Crab]]s. Through the completion of the [[Quest]] "[[Hungry Hunches]]", however, the number of each required ingredient can be reduced to one. Preparing a Salt-Grilled Crab before a [[Challenge]] or [[Scenario]] decreased the amount of damage taken from [[Enemy|Enemies]] by five percent. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:AoC Salt-Grilled Crab Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon for Salt-Grilled Crab ==See Also== {{See Also| * Crab Omelet with Rice * Crab Risotto * Crab Stir-Fry * Food * Meal }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Salt-Grilled Food, Seafood |items= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
